note: audit after the experiment; committed files only

reuse.calib_normals: the same 150 images set every threshold (5 folds x 2 architectures + 2 unseen runs + M + M-reg)
reuse.test_normals: the same 255 images are scored by every model; YOLO pooled FPR = 1,275 evaluations of 255 images
reuse.background_normals: the same 160 FIT normals in every YOLO run (128 train + 32 internal val, split differs by run seed)

label_use.permitted_training_labels: box labels (from masks) of train and internal_val defects of each run
label_use.held_out_evaluation_labels: image labels and masks of each run's test defects: used only for recall, mAP50 (ultralytics val on the test list) and the post-hoc localisation check
label_use.thresholds: CALIB normal scores only (no defect label)
label_use.checkpoint: ultralytics best.pt by its fitness on internal_val (no test image)
